title: Town stars - what they appear to be (UNCONFIRMED)
body:
**Status: community observation, not documented.** The official docs never connect the word "stars" to towns - every star reference in the documentation is about the Critter promotion system (0.2 increments up to 5.0, earned by consuming clones).

Players report a star meter on their **town** that fills as critters gather and return, reaching 5/5.

The leading theory is that this displays **town maturity**, also called loot-ripeness, which IS documented on the Raiding & PvP page. Maturity scales how much a successful raider steals from your Town Bank - a wipe win takes up to 30%, an HP win up to 15%, and maturity determines where in that range you land. The docs state a freshly raided town has little ripe loot and regenerates ripeness over about a day.

**If this theory is right, 5/5 stars is a warning rather than an achievement** - it means your town is at maximum lootability. The counterplay would be shielding, withdrawing to your wallet, or spending the bank down before going offline.

**How to confirm:** watch whether the stars drop after you are raided or after you spend your Town Bank down. If they track your bank balance and reset after a hit, it is maturity. If they do not move, it is something else. Please report findings in Discord.

title: Gacha spins are earned, not a daily free allowance
body:
A common misreading. The Gacha Wheels page says the Blue Wheel is **free**, which means **spinning costs no $QUEST** - it does NOT mean you receive free spins on a daily timer.

Per the Events System page, spins are **earned through participation in Beta tasks, quests, or staking progress**. You can spin one at a time or in bulk up to 25, and a counter shows how many you have remaining. Both wheels live in the **Events area**.

There is no documented daily free spin. Plan voucher income around how many spins you can actually earn, not around a daily faucet.

title: Item market snapshot, 9 Aug 2026
body:
**Dated snapshot - verify before trading.** Taken from the in-game marketplace on 9 Aug 2026, two days after mainnet launch.

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Master floor | 5.03 SOL |
| Clone floor | none listed |
| Item floor | 0.030 SOL |
| Items listed | 596 |
| $QUEST price | $0.07777 |

Composition of the 596 item listings: **567 vouchers, 29 tools, 0 equipment, 0 shards**.

Two things worth knowing. There was **no clone market at all** - zero clones listed anywhere, so there is no observed clearing price for clone mints yet. And **no equipment had ever been listed**, so crafted gear had no demonstrated buyer at this point.

Vouchers cleared at 0.03-0.05 SOL for 5-12 units of basic resources, and sellers were pricing **per voucher rather than per unit** - an 8-unit Herbs voucher at 0.03 sat alongside a 5-unit at 0.05.
